gloss: to attach; to give (a name); to keep (a record)

definitions.gloss: to attach, to fix; to add
definitions.explanation: To attach or fix one thing to another (a key ring to a bag, a name tag to luggage, curtains to a window), or to add something extra to something else (a comment, a reason). Pattern: YにXを{付|つ}ける. The transitive pair of {付|つ}く (to be attached).

definitions.gloss: to give (a name, a price, a title)
definitions.explanation: To give or assign something to someone or something: a name ({名前|なまえ}を{付|つ}ける), a price ({値段|ねだん}を{付|つ}ける), a title, a mark or score.
To keep a regular written record: a diary ({日記|にっき}を{付|つ}ける), the accounts ({帳簿|ちょうぼ}を{付|つ}ける), a log of one's practice or spending.

notes:
{付|つ}ける is the kanji spelling of つける for its 'attach' group of senses. The kana entry つける covers every sense of the verb, including turning things on ({点|つ}ける), lighting a fire, wearing (⟦{着|つ}ける→着く：00680_tsuku⟧), seasoning food, bearing fruit and ⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧ (be careful); this entry shows only the senses normally written {付|つ}ける.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pair: ⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (intransitive): ⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}ける → ⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}く→付く：01960_tsuku⟧
- Pattern: Y⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}ける (attach X to Y)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}ける: give a name
- ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}ける: put a price on
- ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧／⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}ける: attach conditions / give reasons
- ⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧／⟦{帳簿|ちょうぼ}→帳簿：07961_choubo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}ける: keep a diary / the accounts

WRITING:
Many writers use kana つける even for these senses, and ⟦{気|き}をつける→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧ is usually written in kana. A different verb shares the reading: ⟦{漬|つ}ける→漬ける：09861_tsukeru⟧ (to pickle, to soak).
